items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I said a friend of mine in Chicago, Stump Evans

ctx.x: He got a lot of work there. That's his home, you know. But he was raised up in Chicago. And Stump Evans. See, Stump was a trombone player and a saxophone player. He was from out of St. Joe -- out of Kansas City, Missouri.
But what instrument -- what was he playing, alto or tenor?
